001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.simple.props;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.io.StringReader;
006import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
007import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
008import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
009import java.nio.file.Path;
010import java.time.Duration;
011import java.util.ArrayList;
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.Objects;
014import java.util.function.Function;
015import java.util.regex.Pattern;
016
017import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
018
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.EnumAlias;
024
025/**
026 * Resolves {@link LogProperties} from the following layers, highest priority first:
027 * <ol>
028 * <li>The optional watched level file, enabled by {@value #LEVEL_FILE_PROPERTY}. Only
029 * {@code logging.level} and {@code logging.level.*} keys are supplied by this
030 * source.</li>
031 * <li>System properties
032 * ({@link LogProperties.StandardProperties#SYSTEM_PROPERTIES}).</li>
033 * <li>Environment variables, using {@value Builder#DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX} in place of the
034 * {@code "logging."} lead segment of the key, remaining <code>.</code>s replaced with
035 * <code>_</code>, and casing left exactly as-is. The prefix is set by
036 * {@value #ENV_PREFIX_PROPERTY} in the base resource or by
037 * {@link Builder#envPrefix(String)}.</li>
038 * <li>Profile resources selected by {@value #PROFILES_PROPERTY}, first profile wins.
039 * These are loaded only when the base resource exists. An empty selection uses the
040 * optional {@code default} profile; all other profile resources must exist.</li>
041 * <li>A classpath resource (default {@value Builder#DEFAULT_RESOURCE}, configurable)
042 * parsed the same way {@link LogProperties.Builder#fromProperties(String)} parses any
043 * other properties text. If the base resource is absent, this module supplies no property
044 * sources at all.</li>
045 * </ol>
046 * Create one with {@link #builder()}, or just rely on {@link SimplePropertiesProvider}
047 * picking up the defaults automatically via {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}. The provider
048 * reports selected profiles and classpath resource loading through {@link LogAlerts}.
049 * <p>
050 * <b>GraalVM native image</b>: this module bundles a {@code resource-config.json} (at
051 * {@code META-INF/native-image/io.jstach.rainbowgum/rainbowgum-simple-props/}) that
052 * includes {@code logging.properties} and {@code logging-<profile>.properties}
053 * automatically. Profile names contain only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and
054 * hyphens. Custom {@link Builder#resource(String)} names and their profile variants need
055 * corresponding native-image resource metadata.
056 */
057public final class SimpleProperties {
058
059        /**
060         * How resource keys without the logging prefix are treated. The base resource
061         * overrides {@link Builder#strict(StrictType)}. Accepts {@code short} (default),
062         * {@code off} or {@code false}, {@code alert}, and {@code fail} or {@code true}. It
063         * is always written with its full key, even when {@code short} allows other keys
064         * without the logging prefix.
065         * <p>
066         * Property: <code>{@index logging.simpleprops.strict}</code>
067         */
068        public static final String STRICT_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "simpleprops.strict";
069
070        /**
071         * Controls how resource property keys without the logging prefix are treated.
072         */
073        @CaseChanging
074        public enum StrictType {
075
076                /** Disables prefix validation. */
077                @EnumAlias("false")
078                OFF,
079                /**
080                 * Records an error alert for each key without the logging prefix, leaving whether
081                 * startup fails to {@code logging.alerts.fail}, which by default fails on them.
082                 */
083                ALERT,
084                /**
085                 * Records error alerts and fails when supplying properties if any key lacks the
086                 * logging prefix.
087                 */
088                @EnumAlias("true")
089                FAIL,
090                /**
091                 * Keys without the logging prefix get it, in the base resource and profile
092                 * resources: <code>level.com.myco=debug</code> is
093                 * <code>logging.level.com.myco=debug</code>. When both forms of a key are given,
094                 * the later line wins, as with any repeated key. A base resource with keys only
095                 * java.util.logging uses, such as <code>handlers</code> or <code>.level</code>,
096                 * fails like {@link #FAIL}, since its configuration file is also named
097                 * <code>logging.properties</code>.
098                 */
099                SHORT;
100
101                static StrictType parse(String value) {
102                        return switch (value.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) {
103                                case "true" -> FAIL;
104                                case "false" -> OFF;
105                                default -> LogProperty.enumValue(StrictType.class, value, "true", "false");
106                        };
107                }
108
109        }
110
111        /**
112         * The environment variable prefix used in place of the key's {@code "logging."} lead
113         * segment, read only from the base resource, before any environment variable. For
114         * example {@code logging.simpleprops.envPrefix=MYAPP_LOG_} makes
115         * {@code logging.level.com.myapp} the environment variable
116         * {@code MYAPP_LOG_level_com_myapp}. It overrides {@link Builder#envPrefix(String)}.
117         * The prefix must be ASCII letters, digits, and underscores, not start with a digit,
118         * and end with <code>_</code>. It must not start with <code>HTTP_</code> in any case,
119         * since CGI and similar gateways set those variables from request headers.
120         * <p>
121         * Property: <code>{@index logging.simpleprops.envPrefix}</code>
122         */
123        public static final String ENV_PREFIX_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "simpleprops.envPrefix";
124
125        /**
126         * Comma-separated profiles, in priority order. Resolved from system properties,
127         * environment variables, or {@link Builder#profiles(List)}, in that priority order,
128         * after the base classpath resource is found. With the default environment prefix,
129         * use {@code RAINBOWGUM_profiles}. For example,
130         * {@code logging.profiles=local-dev,dev} loads {@code logging-local-dev.properties}
131         * before {@code logging-dev.properties}, with {@code logging.properties} as fallback.
132         * A missing base resource disables all property sources from this module, regardless
133         * of profile selection. With no profiles selected, the optional {@code default}
134         * profile is used. It is not included automatically when other profiles are selected.
135         * A missing selected profile resource fails initialization unless its name is
136         * {@code default}. Files cannot activate additional profiles.
137         * <p>
138         * Property: <code>{@index logging.profiles}</code>
139         */
140        public static final String PROFILES_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "profiles";
141
142        /**
143         * Whether to watch a level file for log levels, see
144         * {@value #LEVEL_FILE_PATH_PROPERTY}. Accepts {@code off} or {@code false} (default)
145         * and {@code watch} or {@code true}. Resolved from system properties, environment
146         * variables, or the base resource, and only when the base resource exists.
147         * <p>
148         * Property: <code>{@index logging.simpleprops.levelFile}</code>
149         */
150        public static final String LEVEL_FILE_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "simpleprops.levelFile";
151
152        /**
153         * Where the watched level file is, default <code>level.properties</code>. A relative
154         * path is resolved against the working directory. Resolved from the same sources as
155         * {@value #LEVEL_FILE_PROPERTY}, never from profile resources or the level file
156         * itself. Where POSIX permissions are available, the file is refused while it or its
157         * directory can be written by group or others, or is owned by someone other than the
158         * user running the application or root. Symbolic links also have their resolved
159         * target's directory checked; a missing symbolic link target is refused.
160         * <p>
161         * Property: <code>{@index logging.simpleprops.levelFilePath}</code>
162         */
163        public static final String LEVEL_FILE_PATH_PROPERTY = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "simpleprops.levelFilePath";
164
165        /**
166         * Whether to watch a level file, see {@value #LEVEL_FILE_PROPERTY}.
167         */
168        @CaseChanging
169        public enum LevelFileType {
170
171                /** No level file. */
172                @EnumAlias("false")
173                OFF,
174                /**
175                 * Polls the level file, see {@value #LEVEL_FILE_PATH_PROPERTY}. Its
176                 * <code>logging.level</code> keys take precedence over every other source, and
177                 * level changes are allowed unless {@code logging.change.mode} or
178                 * {@code logging.change.logger} is set otherwise. Keys may leave off the logging
179                 * prefix: <code>level.com.myco=debug</code> is
180                 * <code>logging.level.com.myco=debug</code>. Other keys in the file are ignored.
181                 */
182                @EnumAlias("true")
183                WATCH;
184
185                static LevelFileType parse(String value) {
186                        return switch (value.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) {
187                                case "true" -> WATCH;
188                                case "false" -> OFF;
189                                default -> LogProperty.enumValue(LevelFileType.class, value, "true", "false");
190                        };
191                }
192
193        }
194
195        private static final Pattern PROFILE_NAME = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_-]+");
196
197        private static final Pattern ENV_PREFIX = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*");
198
199        private static String parseEnvPrefix(String value) {
200                if (!ENV_PREFIX.matcher(value).matches()) {
201                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid environment variable prefix '" + value
202                                        + "': use only ASCII letters, digits, and underscores, not starting with a digit");
203                }
204                if (!value.endsWith("_")) {
205                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid environment variable prefix '" + value
206                                        + "': end it with an underscore, as in '" + value + "_'");
207                }
208                if (value.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("HTTP_")) {
209                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid environment variable prefix '" + value
210                                        + "': CGI and similar gateways set HTTP_ variables from request headers (see httpoxy)");
211                }
212                return value;
213        }
214
215        private final List<LogProperties> properties;
216
217        private final List<String> infoMessages;
218
219        private final List<String> errorMessages;
220
221        private final StrictType strict;
222
223        private final @Nullable LevelFileProperties levelFile;
224
225        private SimpleProperties(List<LogProperties> properties, List<String> infoMessages, List<String> errorMessages,
226                        StrictType strict, @Nullable LevelFileProperties levelFile) {
227                this.properties = properties;
228                this.infoMessages = infoMessages;
229                this.errorMessages = errorMessages;
230                this.strict = strict;
231                this.levelFile = levelFile;
232        }
233
234        /*
235         * The watched level file, when enabled.
236         */
237        @Nullable LevelFileProperties levelFile() {
238                return levelFile;
239        }
240
241        /**
242         * The layers described in this class's javadoc, highest priority first.
243         * @return properties, highest priority first.
244         * @throws IllegalArgumentException if strict validation is {@link StrictType#FAIL}
245         * and the base resource has unprefixed keys, or is {@link StrictType#SHORT} and the
246         * base resource has java.util.logging keys.
247         */
248        public List<LogProperties> properties() {
249                if ((strict == StrictType.FAIL || strict == StrictType.SHORT) && !errorMessages.isEmpty()) {
250                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
251                                        "Invalid simple-props base resource:\n" + String.join("\n", errorMessages));
252                }
253                return properties;
254        }
255
256        void reportAlerts(LogAlerts alerts) {
257                for (var message : infoMessages) {
258                        alerts.config(SimpleProperties.class, Level.INFO, message, null);
259                }
260                for (var message : errorMessages) {
261                        alerts.config(SimpleProperties.class, Level.ERROR, message, null);
262                }
263        }
264
265        private record ProfileResources(List<String> names, List<LogProperties> properties, List<String> resources) {
266        }
267
268        /**
269         * Creates a builder.
270         * @return builder.
271         */
272        public static Builder builder() {
273                return new Builder();
274        }
275
276        /**
277         * Builds a {@link SimpleProperties}.
278         */
279        public static final class Builder {
280
281                /**
282                 * Default environment variable prefix: {@value #DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX}.
283                 */
284                public static final String DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX = "RAINBOWGUM_";
285
286                /**
287                 * Default classpath resource: {@value #DEFAULT_RESOURCE}.
288                 */
289                public static final String DEFAULT_RESOURCE = "classpath:/logging.properties";
290
291                private String envPrefix = DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX;
292
293                private String resource = DEFAULT_RESOURCE;
294
295                private List<String> profiles = List.of();
296
297                private StrictType strict = StrictType.SHORT;
298
299                /**
300                 * Sets how resource keys without the logging prefix are treated. The base
301                 * resource's {@value SimpleProperties#STRICT_PROPERTY} overrides this setting.
302                 * {@link StrictType#ALERT} and {@link StrictType#FAIL} record error alerts, and
303                 * {@link StrictType#FAIL} also stops initialization when properties are supplied.
304                 * @param strict mode, default {@link StrictType#SHORT}.
305                 * @return this.
306                 */
307                public Builder strict(StrictType strict) {
308                        this.strict = Objects.requireNonNull(strict);
309                        return this;
310                }
311
312                private Function<String, @Nullable String> envLookup = System::getenv;
313
314                private Path levelFilePath = Path.of(LevelFileProperties.FILE_NAME);
315
316                private Duration levelFilePollInterval = LevelFileProperties.POLL_INTERVAL;
317
318                private Builder() {
319                }
320
321                /**
322                 * Sets the environment variable prefix used in place of the key's
323                 * {@code "logging."} lead segment (for example {@code logging.level.com.myapp}
324                 * becomes {@code RAINBOWGUM_level_com_myapp} with the default prefix). Casing is
325                 * not changed: only the prefix and the <code>.</code> to <code>_</code>
326                 * replacement are applied, so a key with mixed-case segments produces a
327                 * mixed-case environment variable name. The base resource's
328                 * {@value SimpleProperties#ENV_PREFIX_PROPERTY} overrides this setting, and the
329                 * prefix has the same rules.
330                 * @param envPrefix prefix, default {@value #DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIX}.
331                 * @return this.
332                 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the prefix breaks the rules of
333                 * {@value SimpleProperties#ENV_PREFIX_PROPERTY}.
334                 */
335                public Builder envPrefix(String envPrefix) {
336                        this.envPrefix = parseEnvPrefix(Objects.requireNonNull(envPrefix));
337                        return this;
338                }
339
340                /**
341                 * Sets the classpath resource to load properties from. A leading
342                 * {@code classpath:} scheme (with or without a following <code>/</code>) is
343                 * stripped before resolving; the remainder is resolved as a plain classpath
344                 * resource name. Profile names are inserted before a trailing {@code .properties}
345                 * extension, or appended with a hyphen if there is no such extension. A missing
346                 * base resource makes this module supply no property sources, regardless of
347                 * profile selection. Missing selected profile resources fail when the base
348                 * resource exists, except for the optional {@code default} profile.
349                 * @apiNote unlike the default resource name, a custom one here is not covered by
350                 * this module's bundled GraalVM {@code resource-config.json} - see this class's
351                 * javadoc.
352                 * @param resource classpath resource, default {@value #DEFAULT_RESOURCE}.
353                 * @return this.
354                 */
355                public Builder resource(String resource) {
356                        this.resource = Objects.requireNonNull(resource);
357                        return this;
358                }
359
360                /**
361                 * Sets fallback profiles in priority order. A system property or environment
362                 * variable for {@value SimpleProperties#PROFILES_PROPERTY} overrides this list,
363                 * including when it selects no profiles. Profile names must contain only ASCII
364                 * letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. An empty selection uses the optional
365                 * {@code default} profile.
366                 * @param profiles fallback profile names, first profile wins.
367                 * @return this.
368                 */
369                public Builder profiles(List<String> profiles) {
370                        this.profiles = List.copyOf(profiles);
371                        return this;
372                }
373
374                /**
375                 * Sets fallback profiles in priority order.
376                 * @param profiles fallback profile names, first profile wins.
377                 * @return this.
378                 * @see #profiles(List)
379                 */
380                public Builder profiles(String... profiles) {
381                        return profiles(List.of(profiles));
382                }
383
384                /*
385                 * Test-only hook so env var mapping can be tested without setting real
386                 * environment variables (which the JVM cannot do portably at test time).
387                 */
388                Builder envLookup(Function<String, @Nullable String> envLookup) {
389                        this.envLookup = Objects.requireNonNull(envLookup);
390                        return this;
391                }
392
393                /*
394                 * Test-only hook so the default level file need not be in the working directory
395                 * and tests need not wait seconds for a poll.
396                 */
397                Builder levelFilePath(Path levelFilePath, Duration pollInterval) {
398                        this.levelFilePath = Objects.requireNonNull(levelFilePath);
399                        this.levelFilePollInterval = Objects.requireNonNull(pollInterval);
400                        return this;
401                }
402
403                /**
404                 * Builds the {@link SimpleProperties}.
405                 * @return simple properties.
406                 */
407                public SimpleProperties build() {
408                        var classpathProperties = loadResource(resource);
409                        if (classpathProperties == LogProperties.StandardProperties.EMPTY) {
410                                return new SimpleProperties(List.of(), List.of("No properties resource found: " + resource), List.of(),
411                                                strict, null);
412                        }
413                        var strictType = classpathProperties.forKey(STRICT_PROPERTY)
414                                .ofString()
415                                .map(StrictType::parse)
416                                .or(strict)
417                                .validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
418                        List<String> errorMessages = List.of();
419                        if (classpathProperties instanceof SimpleLogProperties simple) {
420                                errorMessages = switch (strictType) {
421                                        case OFF -> List.of();
422                                        case ALERT, FAIL -> simple.prefixErrors();
423                                        case SHORT -> simple.julErrors();
424                                };
425                        }
426                        boolean shortKeys = strictType == StrictType.SHORT;
427                        if (shortKeys) {
428                                classpathProperties = withShortKeys(classpathProperties);
429                        }
430                        var envPrefix = classpathProperties.forKey(ENV_PREFIX_PROPERTY)
431                                .ofString()
432                                .map(SimpleProperties::parseEnvPrefix)
433                                .or(this.envPrefix)
434                                .validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
435                        var systemProperties = LogProperties.StandardProperties.SYSTEM_PROPERTIES;
436                        var environmentVariables = new EnvVarProperties(envPrefix, envLookup);
437                        var preProperties = LogProperties.of(List.of(systemProperties, environmentVariables));
438                        var profileResources = preProperties.forKey(PROFILES_PROPERTY).ofList().or(profiles).map(names -> {
439                                if (names.isEmpty()) {
440                                        names = List.of("default");
441                                }
442                                var layers = new ArrayList<LogProperties>();
443                                var resources = new ArrayList<String>();
444                                for (var name : names) {
445                                        if (!PROFILE_NAME.matcher(name).matches()) {
446                                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid profile name '" + name
447                                                                + "': use only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens");
448                                        }
449                                        String profileResource = resource.endsWith(".properties")
450                                                        ? resource.substring(0, resource.length() - ".properties".length()) + "-" + name
451                                                                        + ".properties"
452                                                        : resource + "-" + name;
453                                        var profileProperties = loadResource(profileResource);
454                                        if (shortKeys) {
455                                                profileProperties = withShortKeys(profileProperties);
456                                        }
457                                        if (profileProperties == LogProperties.StandardProperties.EMPTY) {
458                                                if (name.equals("default")) {
459                                                        continue;
460                                                }
461                                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing classpath resource '" + profileResource
462                                                                + "' for selected profile '" + name + "'");
463                                        }
464                                        layers.add(profileProperties);
465                                        resources.add(profileResource);
466                                }
467                                return new ProfileResources(List.copyOf(names), List.copyOf(layers), List.copyOf(resources));
468                        }).validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
469                        var properties = new ArrayList<LogProperties>();
470                        properties.add(systemProperties);
471                        properties.add(environmentVariables);
472                        properties.addAll(profileResources.properties());
473                        properties.add(classpathProperties);
474                        var infoMessages = new ArrayList<String>();
475                        infoMessages.add("Found profiles: " + profileResources.names());
476                        infoMessages.add("Loaded properties resource: " + resource);
477                        for (var profileResource : profileResources.resources()) {
478                                infoMessages.add("Loaded properties resource: " + profileResource);
479                        }
480                        var operatorProperties = LogProperties
481                                .of(List.of(systemProperties, environmentVariables, classpathProperties));
482                        var levelFileType = operatorProperties.forKey(LEVEL_FILE_PROPERTY)
483                                .ofString()
484                                .map(LevelFileType::parse)
485                                .or(LevelFileType.OFF)
486                                .validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
487                        LevelFileProperties levelFile = null;
488                        if (levelFileType == LevelFileType.WATCH) {
489                                var path = operatorProperties.forKey(LEVEL_FILE_PATH_PROPERTY)
490                                        .ofString()
491                                        .map(Path::of)
492                                        .or(levelFilePath)
493                                        .validateNow(SimpleProperties.class);
494                                levelFile = new LevelFileProperties(path, levelFilePollInterval);
495                                properties.add(0, levelFile);
496                                // Lowest precedence so explicit change settings still win.
497                                properties.add(LogProperties.builder()
498                                        .fromProperties(LogProperties.CHANGE_MODE_PROPERTY + "=on\n" + LogProperties.CHANGE_LOGGER_PREFIX
499                                                        + "=level")
500                                        .description("LEVEL_FILE_DEFAULT")
501                                        .order(0)
502                                        .build());
503                                infoMessages.add("Watching level file: " + levelFile.path());
504                        }
505                        return new SimpleProperties(List.copyOf(properties), List.copyOf(infoMessages), errorMessages, strictType,
506                                        levelFile);
507                }
508
509                private static LogProperties withShortKeys(LogProperties properties) {
510                        return properties instanceof SimpleLogProperties simple ? simple.withShortKeys() : properties;
511                }
512
513                private static LogProperties loadResource(String resource) {
514                        String path = resource;
515                        if (path.startsWith("classpath:")) {
516                                path = path.substring("classpath:".length());
517                        }
518                        while (path.startsWith("/")) {
519                                path = path.substring(1);
520                        }
521                        ClassLoader cl = SimpleProperties.class.getClassLoader();
522                        if (cl == null) {
523                                cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
524                        }
525                        try (InputStream in = cl == null ? null : cl.getResourceAsStream(path)) {
526                                if (in == null) {
527                                        return LogProperties.StandardProperties.EMPTY;
528                                }
529                                String content = new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
530                                return SimpleLogProperties.read(new StringReader(content), resource);
531                        }
532                        catch (IOException e) {
533                                throw new UncheckedIOException("Failed to read classpath resource: " + resource, e);
534                        }
535                }
536
537        }
538
539}
